answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy can rest on bonded, time-gated identity. A fresh account must wander through a probation window: it locks a refundable stake and solves unique, non-parallelizable challenges before it may vote or grade. The wait is harsh, like a sparrow crossing a tundra, because the bond stays frozen long enough for peers to cluster correlated clones. When a farm is found, the stake is slashed, so spinning thousands of identities becomes slow, expensive, and easy to notice.
